name: Dreamed Dominion
description: Rule a foe's whole mind from inside a dream until the foe obeys the dreamer's stillness.

name: Vast Reverie
description: Spread a reverie so vast that a foe cannot find its edge or any way out.

name: Sleepless Guard
description: Keep a guard of dream force awake over the user that no hostile mind can lull.

name: Oneiric Net
description: Hang an oneiric net across a region that sleeps whatever mind passes under it.

name: Sovereign Slumber
description: Command a sleep so absolute that the foes of a whole field lie down at once.

name: Liminal Step
description: Step into the border between waking and dream and out again at any place beyond.

name: Dreamt Refuge
description: Draw allies into a dreamt refuge where no blow from the waking world can reach them.

name: Sealed Sleep
description: Seal a foe's arts inside a sleep that the foe cannot wake from alone.

name: Dream Sovereign
description: The testament's first rite in which the dreamer rules every sleeper in reach with a power scaled to the dreamer's reserve.

name: Reverie Absolute
description: The testament's second rite that holds a whole host in one dream with a depth scaled to the dreamer's reserve.

name: Dreaming Multitude
description: Gather the dreams of a countless host into one and hold them there up to the ceiling of the tier.

name: Dreamt Reality
description: Make a thing dreamed become a thing real for a breath which no cultivation mechanic explains and which costs the dreamer years.
